commenti.body: What are some examples you think are contradictory? Tarkovsky always plays with the idea that the characters are trying to reconcile their faith in God with a world that doesn't seem to care about faith and God. It always seemed to me that Tarkovksy is using his movies as a way to process his own thoughts and doubts about God through the use of his characters and the godless world they inhabit. When we watch his movies we can learn more about what it would mean to have faith in a faithless world.

This contradiction has always been interesting to me. Each time I watch it my theory changes. My current theory is that the entire middle of the movie after the prayer can be viewed as a dream. This includes the visit to the witch, which   mirrors the sacrificial ethic of the non-dream scenes. Totally my idiot take, but it works for me.
